title: anthyllis vulneraria f. font-queri
intro: Anthyllis vulneraria f. font-queri, commonly known as kidney vetch, is a flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to act as a diuretic and support kidney function, making it a possible treatment for conditions such as kidney stones and urinary tract infections. The therapeutic actions of kidney vetch are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, that have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Furthermore, its bioactive constituents may also contribute to its potential to reduce blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health.
